XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for blocks/feedback_tracker. Tables track per-submission SLA ledger, materialized rollups, daily trend, site stats, dirty queue, the platform academic calendar (days + weekly business hours + manual pause windows), a recompute audit log, and per-course backfill cursors (renamed cursor → lastsubid because CURSOR is reserved in MariaDB). Pause-window data is derived on demand by the calendar engine — no persisted pause ledger since v2.0.0.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_sub
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-submission SLA ledger; one row per (cmid, userid, attemptnumber, cycle). Source of truth for all downstream rollups. A cycle is one measurement of teacher response: work resubmitted after it was already marked opens a new cycle instead of rewriting the closed one, so a completed response time is never destroyed.

FIELD.NAME: cycle
FIELD.COMMENT: Measurement index within one attempt. 0 is the original hand-in; N greater than 0 is work resubmitted after cycle N-1 already carried a mark (core's Graded - resubmitted state). Closed cycles are never rewritten by later student activity, so a completed response time survives a resubmission.

FIELD.NAME: timemarked
FIELD.COMMENT: assign_grades.timemodified, stored only when the mark postdates this cycle's hand-in. Equals timegraded when marking workflow is off; earlier than timereleased when the mark waited for release. Reference against which the next resubmission is detected.

FIELD.NAME: timereleased
FIELD.COMMENT: Instant the marking-workflow state reached released, i.e. when the feedback actually reached the student. mod_assign persists no such timestamp (assign_user_flags has no time columns on any supported version), so it is captured from the workflow_state_updated event. Null when marking workflow is off.

FIELD.NAME: timeclosed
FIELD.COMMENT: The instant the teacher's response landed: timereleased when the activity uses marking workflow, timegraded otherwise. Deliberately NOT a coalesce of the two - on a workflow activity a mark that was never released has not reached anybody. Stored rather than derived so the predicate stays indexable.

FIELD.NAME: islatest
FIELD.COMMENT: Mirror of assign_submission.latest. Core gates every needs-grading read on s.latest = 1; without it a superseded attempt stays pending for ever.

FIELD.NAME: iscurrent
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 on the highest cycle of an attempt, 0 on superseded cycles, so one attempt contributes exactly one live observation to pending counts and current-state medians.

FIELD.NAME: gradestate
FIELD.COMMENT: assign get_grading_status() verbatim: graded, notgraded, or a marking-workflow state (notmarked, inmarking, readyforreview, inreview, readyforrelease, released).

FIELD.NAME: teamgroupid
FIELD.COMMENT: assign_submission.groupid the row was derived from; 0 for individual assignments. Non-zero rows were fanned out from a team submission.

FIELD.NAME: timeallocated
FIELD.COMMENT: Instant a marker was FIRST allocated to this submission, closing the coordination queue. Sticky: re-allocation never moves it. mod_assign persists no allocation timestamp on any supported version, so the moment is only ever knowable when observed - it cannot be recovered later.

FIELD.NAME: timeallocmarker
FIELD.COMMENT: Instant the CURRENT marker was allocated; moves on reassignment. Separate from timeallocated so a marker who inherited a long-queued submission is measured from their own start, not the first allocation.

FIELD.NAME: allocmarkerid
FIELD.COMMENT: User id of the currently allocated marker, re-read from core rather than taken from the event payload; 0 when unallocated.

FIELD.NAME: allocsource
FIELD.COMMENT: How the allocation stamp was obtained: observed (from a marker_updated event, exact) or late (the allocation landed at or after the grading, so the marker interval is unmeasurable). Null when never allocated - which on 4.5 and 5.1 includes every allocation made through quick grading or the grading form, since only the batch operation fires an event and no reconciliation sweep covers this yet.

FIELD.NAME: queuehours
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective hours from hand-in to the FIRST allocation: how long the work waited for someone to be made responsible for it. Belongs to whoever runs the allocation, not to the marker.

FIELD.NAME: allochours
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective hours from the CURRENT marker's allocation to the grading: the marker's own turnaround, with the coordination queue excluded. Null when the interval is unmeasurable (never allocated, or allocated at or after the grading).

FIELD.NAME: allocdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Elapsed business days for the marker turnaround; the day-ruler twin of allochours.

FIELD.NAME: allocbucket
FIELD.COMMENT: Band of the marker turnaround against the allocation goal; null whenever allochours is.

FIELD.NAME: waitinghours
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw wall-clock hours from submission to grading (or now).

FIELD.NAME: effectivehours
FIELD.COMMENT: Business/academic hours via the academic_time engine.

FIELD.NAME: effectivedays
FIELD.COMMENT: Elapsed business (active) days, date-based via day_counter; maintained wherever effectivehours is. Drives banding when the business-days display unit is active.

FIELD.NAME: effectivecalver
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar version at last effective-hours compute; used by recompute_pending to detect staleness.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_group
TABLE.COMMENT: Materialized rollup per (courseid, groupid). Read-side cache for the dashboard cards.

FIELD.NAME: cur_median_eff_h
FIELD.COMMENT: Median effective hours over graded-in-window plus currently-pending submissions; the display headline (includes the backlog). Not used by the score.

FIELD.NAME: cur_median_raw_h
FIELD.COMMENT: Median raw (wall-clock) hours over graded-in-window plus currently-pending submissions; the perceived-wait headline.

FIELD.NAME: cur_median_eff_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Median elapsed business (active) days over graded-in-window plus currently-pending submissions; date-based headline for the business-days display unit. Not used by the score.

FIELD.NAME: cur_median_perc_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Median elapsed calendar days over graded-in-window plus currently-pending submissions; date-based perceived headline.

FIELD.NAME: critical_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Pending count past the business-days critical cutoff; the day-ruler twin of critical (which feeds the score and stays hour-based).

FIELD.NAME: overgoal_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Pending count between the business-days goal and critical cutoffs; day-ruler twin of overgoal.

FIELD.NAME: compliance_pct_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Percentage of last-window graded submissions returned within the business-days SLA goal (sla_goal_days); display-only day-ruler twin of compliance_pct. Not used by the score.

FIELD.NAME: comp_compliance
FIELD.COMMENT: Compliance term value [0,1]; multiplied by W_compliance for score contribution.

FIELD.NAME: comp_median
FIELD.COMMENT: Median term value [0,1].

FIELD.NAME: comp_critical
FIELD.COMMENT: Critical term value [0,1].

FIELD.NAME: comp_pending
FIELD.COMMENT: Pending term value [0,1].

FIELD.NAME: comp_trend
FIELD.COMMENT: Trend term value [0,1]; defaults to 0.5 when no prior window exists.

FIELD.NAME: unallocated
FIELD.COMMENT: Pending submissions with no marker allocated yet: work nobody has been made responsible for. Null when the activity set does not use marking allocation.

FIELD.NAME: median_queue_h
FIELD.COMMENT: Median effective hours from hand-in to first allocation over the graded window; the coordination lead time.

FIELD.NAME: median_alloc_h
FIELD.COMMENT: Median effective hours from allocation to grading over the graded window; the marker turnaround, with the coordination queue excluded.

FIELD.NAME: alloc_coverage_pct
FIELD.COMMENT: Share of the graded window carrying a usable marker-turnaround measurement. Published beside median_alloc_h because mod_assign fires an allocation event on only one of its three allocation paths before 5.2, so the sample is partial by construction and the median must never be read without it.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_trend
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-day median waiting hours for the 30-day sparkline; one row per (courseid, groupid, day).

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_site
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-wide daily stats for school-comparison overlays; one row per day.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_queue
TABLE.COMMENT: Dirty queue of (courseid, groupid) tuples awaiting recompute; drained every 5 minutes.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_cday
TABLE.COMMENT: Platform academic calendar: per-day exceptions to the weekly schedule.

FIELD.NAME: starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional sub-day event start (minutes since midnight, 0..1439); null = full-day rule.

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional sub-day event end (minutes since midnight, 1..1440); null = full-day rule.

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_chours
TABLE.COMMENT: Platform academic calendar: weekly business hours (team active window). Multiple rows per dayofweek permitted (split shifts).

FIELD.NAME: dayofweek
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=Mon ... 6=Sun (ISO 8601)

FIELD.NAME: starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes since midnight; 0..1439

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes since midnight; 1..1440

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_cpause
TABLE.COMMENT: Manual SLA pause windows. Three scope levels only: site, course, group.

FIELD.NAME: scopeid
FIELD.COMMENT: courseid for course; groupid for group; 0 for site

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle context id at create time, for capability checks

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = open-ended; engine clips at read horizon

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Recompute audit log; traceability for bulk recomputes and large calendar edits. Pruned daily after 90 days.

FIELD.NAME: triggeredby
FIELD.COMMENT: userid that triggered, or NULL for tasks

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: { groups_touched, subs_touched, took_ms, ... }

TABLE.NAME: block_feedback_tracker_bfcursor
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course backfill cursor — tracks how far backfill_history has progressed through {assign_submission} for each block-enabled course. Lazily created on first backfill tick for a course; removed by course_deleted observer.

FIELD.NAME: lastsubid
FIELD.COMMENT: Last assign_submission.id dispatched for this course; next tick processes rows with id > lastsubid. Named lastsubid rather than cursor because CURSOR is reserved in MariaDB and INSERT/UPDATE fail without quoting.

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = dispatcher should walk this course; 0 = complete (no more rows past cursor at last tick). Admin can reset to 1 to retry.

FIELD.NAME: lastrunat
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts of last dispatcher pass for this course.
